file_roles.evidence: vers_scan_min_max called file->ha_external_lock(thd, F_RDLCK/F_UNLCK) directly on partition handlers; the diff replaces this with a Table_locker using lock_tables, so the handler lock type stays consistent (assert m_lock_type == 2 in ha_close).
Adds a TABLE_LIST(TABLE&, thr_lock_type) constructor used by the new Table_locker and vers_setup_stats; helper only.

rationale: The lock was taken on the partition handler outside the normal table lock, and after a lock-wait timeout the lock type was left inconsistent, so ha_close asserted later. The change is in the versioning partition code.
